name: File Blocker NG
description: Block file uploads based on configurable extensions, MIME types, and deep inspection to protect against malware and ClickFix attacks.

settings_schema.header:
### Mattermost File Blocker NG
Configure file extension, MIME type, and deep inspection rules to prevent unauthorized or malicious file uploads.
settings_schema.footer: For enterprise security assistance or custom rule additions, please consult your organization's IT Security policy.

settings.help_text: When enabled, the plugin intercepts file uploads and applies filtering rules.
Choose whether to block specified extensions (Blacklist / Deny List) or only allow specified extensions (Whitelist / Allow List).

options.display_name: Blacklist (Deny specified extensions and MIME types)

settings.help_text: Comma-separated list of file extensions to block (case-insensitive, e.g. exe, bat, cmd, sh, ps1, dll, lnk). Double extensions (e.g. .pdf.exe) are automatically inspected.
settings.placeholder: exe, bat, cmd, sh, bash, ps1, psm1, dll, com, vbs, js, hta, scr, pif, reg, lnk
settings.default: exe, bat, cmd, sh, bash, ps1, psm1, dll, com, vbs, js, hta, scr, pif, reg, lnk

settings.help_text: Comma-separated list of permitted extensions when Whitelist Mode is selected (e.g. pdf, doc, docx, xls, png, jpg). Any extension not listed will be rejected.
settings.placeholder: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, txt, zip
settings.default: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, txt, zip

settings.help_text: Comma-separated list of MIME types or wildcards to block (e.g. application/x-msdownload, application/x-sh, application/x-bat, application/x-executable).

settings.display_name: Enable Deep Content Inspection (Magic Bytes & Script Sniffing):
settings.help_text: Inspect the first bytes of uploads to detect disguised executables (PE/ELF/Mach-O) and script shebangs/ClickFix signatures even if renamed to .txt or .pdf.
When enabled, ZIP uploads are inspected for contained files matching blocked extensions (preventing ClickFix payloads packaged inside zip archives).
Allow system administrators to bypass file upload restrictions.
Comma-separated list of Mattermost Channel IDs where file blocking rules will NOT be enforced (e.g. dedicated IT admin or testing channels).

Optional custom message presented to users when a file upload is blocked. Leave empty to automatically use the user's localized language message (Traditional Chinese / English). Supported placeholders: {{filename}}, {{extension}}, {{reason}}.
settings.placeholder: Leave empty to use automatic localized message, or enter custom policy text...

settings.help_text: Channel ID where automated security alert messages will be posted when an upload is blocked. Leave empty to disable bot notifications.
